answer: According to Section 2(21) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, 'movable property' encompasses property of every description, excluding land and things that are attached to the earth or permanently fastened to anything that is attached to the earth. This definition is crucial for understanding various legal contexts, including theft, as outlined in subsequent sections.
summary_answer: Movable property under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita includes all property types except land and items permanently attached to the earth.

final_answer: Movable property is defined as property of every description except land and things attached to the earth, as per Section 2(21) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023.
